about.title: About
about.description: Soul Jewelry makes sculptural silver for every day. Bright, minimal, and made to be worn.
about.headline: Made to stand out.
about.intro: Soul is a jewelry house for pieces you actually wear. Sculptural silver, a few warmer hoops, and an order line that is simply WhatsApp.
about.heroAlt: A model in black wearing a sculptural silver ring and earring.

notes.title: A bright finish
notes.text: Pieces are chosen for how they take the light — polished silver, and the occasional warmer metal.

notes.title: A form that lasts
notes.text: One gesture, not a pile of them. A wave, a softened square, an edge that looks poured.

notes.title: Worn, not saved
notes.text: Minimal on purpose, so a piece can stay on from the first hour of the day.

about.handAlt: Hand with a silver wave ring and the Soul mark.
about.lineCopy: Dalğa is the wave — a stud and an open ring. Cubic is the softened square hoop, 18 mm. Aura is a molten stud, a star redrawn as silver. Around them, a resin hoop and a few open bands.
about.orderTitle: Write on WhatsApp. The rest stays in that chat.

steps.title: Write
steps.text: Send the piece, the size, or that it is a gift. The line is open every day, {from}–{to}.

steps.title: Reply
steps.text: We answer in the same chat and confirm the piece, usually the same day.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: Delivery goes to the six districts around the center, or to four metro stations, in about 2–3 days. The place is set in the chat. If it is a gift, say so — it leaves in a dark box, a cloth pouch, and a card.

faq.a: Earrings are studs or hoops. Cubic is 18 mm. The Dalğa ring is one size and opens slightly. Open rings flex a little to the finger. If you are unsure of a finger size, ask on WhatsApp.

faq.q: How do I care for the silver?
faq.a: Wipe it with a soft dry cloth. Keep perfume, cream, and water off it. Store it in the pouch when you are not wearing it.

faq.q: How long does a reply take?
faq.a: We read the WhatsApp line every day, {from}–{to}. We usually write back the same day.
